description: Erection of front and rear roof extensions at main roof level; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; excavation of the front garden to form a lightwell, in connection with the enlargement of the existing basement; installation of 2no. photovoltaic solar panels to the flat roof at main roof level of the existing rear roof extension; installation of a window to replace existing French doors and Juliet balcony to the rear elevation at first floor level.
